description: Add a CLI flag while preserving existing behavior.
input: Add a --status flag to app.py. Running python app.py --status should print ok. Existing --name behavior must still work.

files.app.py:
import argparse


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--name", default="Sema")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(f"hello {args.name}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
